articles.summary: Wood Dale, Illinois — AAR CORP. (NYSE: AIR), the leading parts, repair, and software platform in the aviation aftermarket, is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work® for the second consecutive year.
articles.title: AAR earns 2026 Great Place To Work Certification™

articles.summary: Wood Dale, Illinois — AAR CORP., the leading parts, repair, and software platform in the aviation aftermarket, hosted Jackie Black, Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Division Manager for Aircraft Maintenance, for visits to the Company’s Engineering Services and Airframe Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) operations in Greensboro, North Carolina last week.
articles.title: AAR showcases safety culture and expanded engineering capabilities during FAA visit

articles.summary: AAR CORP., the leading parts, repair, and software platform in the aviation aftermarket, hosted a ribbon cutting ceremony today to celebrate the expansion of its Airframe MRO footprint in Miami.
articles.title: AAR celebrates ribbon cutting for Airframe MRO facility expansion in Miami

articles.summary: Wood Dale, Illinois — AAR CORP. (NYSE: AIR), the leading parts, repair, and software platform in the aviation aftermarket, announced that Sanjay Sood joined the Company as Senior Vice President and Chief Digital & Technology Officer, effective today.
articles.title: AAR names Sanjay Sood Senior Vice President and Chief Digital & Technology Officer
